intro.title: The village’s own groundwater champions.
intro.lede: “Groundwater informed”: local volunteers who connect careful observation with community knowledge and collective action.

photo.alt: A Bhujal Jankaar measuring a village well

right.lead: A Bhujal Jankaar makes groundwater science legible—well by well, season by season, village by village.
paragraphs: These trained volunteers measure wells, rainfall, water quality and check dams. They interpret local patterns, explain them in the community’s own language and help farmers see that groundwater is both limited and shared.

features.title: Measure consistently
features.text: Build a trustworthy local record through simple, repeated observations.

features.title: Interpret locally
features.text: Connect readings with crops, rainfall, pumping and village experience.

features.title: Communicate openly
features.text: Take groundwater information into schools, meetings and farm decisions.

features.title: Support cooperation
features.text: Help communities discuss recharge, demand and fair use together.
